content.user_title: Run a Sci-Fi Distress Signal Roleplay
content.value_statement: Interactive survival stories need a strong opening and clear choices. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code run Stella Chen's crash distress scene.
actual_capabilities: Introduces Stella Chen as a stranded astronaut after a spacecraft crash.
Provides staged dialogue beats for the first distress signal scene.
Offers player choice points for fire control, evacuation, and equipment recovery.
Defines Stella's voice, emotional state, and mixed Chinese-English speaking style.
Lists branching chapter outcomes and recommended follow-up chapters.
Sets survival details such as injuries, supplies, oxygen loss, and unknown terrain.
limitations: Covers only the opening chapter of the larger story.
Does not include runnable code, tools, or automated game state tracking.
Requires the model to maintain continuity across player choices.
Contains Chinese source text, so localization may need review for other audiences.

use_cases.title: Interactive Fiction Writers
use_cases.description: Prototype a tense first chapter with clear beats, choices, and branch outcomes.

use_cases.title: Roleplay Game Hosts
use_cases.description: Run a guided survival scene where players advise Stella during immediate post-crash decisions.

use_cases.title: AI Prompt Builders
use_cases.description: Study a complete character brief, scene structure, and dialogue pacing for roleplay prompts.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Open Contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Start the distress signal scene. Roleplay as Stella Chen and send the first two short messages.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Assess Damage
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue after the player says, 'Check your injuries first.' Keep Stella professional, scared, and concise.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Handle Branching
prompt_templates.prompt: Branch the chapter after the player chooses evacuation. Show consequences, inventory, and the next survival choice.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Run Full Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full opening chapter as Stella. Track oxygen, battery, supplies, injuries, and trust while staying in character.

output_examples.input: Player asks whether Stella is safe.
output_examples.output: Stella answers in short, anxious messages, checks injuries, and reports smoke, oxygen loss, and a jammed hatch.

output_examples.input: Player tells Stella to evacuate immediately.
output_examples.output: The scene moves outside the wreck, preserves Stella's survival pack, and reveals the alien forest and two suns.

output: She compares water, shelter, and signal priorities.
She asks the player to choose the next direction.

best_practices: Keep Stella's messages short during urgent moments.
Offer two or three clear choices at each decision point.
Reflect player advice before introducing the next survival problem.
anti_patterns: Do not make Stella unrealistically powerful or fearless.
Do not reveal the planet's mysteries too quickly.
Do not ignore player choices after presenting options.

faq.question: Is this a coding skill?
faq.answer: No. It is a narrative roleplay skill for interactive fiction.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run external commands?
faq.answer: No. The file contains Markdown dialogue examples, not executable commands.

faq.question: Can I use it for English sessions?
faq.answer: Yes. The source is Chinese with mixed English terms, so translation may be needed.

faq.question: Does it include later chapters?
faq.answer: No. It recommends follow-up chapters but only defines the distress signal opening.

faq.question: Can it track game state automatically?
faq.answer: No. The model or host must track choices, supplies, and continuity.
